goal: Redesign the TUI from a view-switching layout into a polished pane-based dashboard. Replace the current architecture where App.tsx conditionally renders one full-screen view at a time (progress → dashboard → detail → specs) with a layout where findings list, detail, and specs panes are visible simultaneously. The user can switch focus between panes with Tab while always seeing context. The existing pure helpers, types, and ProgressView are preserved. Old state-machine.ts functions are kept for backward compatibility.

steps.title: Create pane-based state machine with comprehensive tests
steps.description:
Create `src/tui/dashboard-state.ts` as a NEW file alongside the existing `state-machine.ts` (do not modify the old file yet). This module defines the pane-focused navigation model.

Types to define:
- `DashboardPane = 'findings' | 'detail' | 'specs'`
- `DashboardPhase = 'loading' | 'ready'`
- `DashboardState = { phase: DashboardPhase; activePane: DashboardPane; selectedIndex: number; detailScrollOffset: number; specsVisible: boolean; shouldExit: boolean }`
- `DashboardAction` union: `PIPELINE_COMPLETE` (loading→ready, focus findings), `SELECT_FINDING` (update selectedIndex + focus detail pane), `FOCUS_NEXT_PANE` (cycle activePane forward: findings→detail→specs(if visible)→findings), `FOCUS_PREV_PANE` (cycle backward), `TOGGLE_SPECS` (toggle specsVisible; if hiding specs and activePane was 'specs', move focus to 'detail'), `MOVE_UP` (in findings: decrement selectedIndex clamped to 0; in detail: decrement detailScrollOffset clamped to 0; in specs: no-op), `MOVE_DOWN` (in findings: increment selectedIndex clamped to findingsCount-1; in detail: increment detailScrollOffset; in specs: no-op), `QUIT` (set shouldExit=true), `BACK` (no-op in pane model, but keep for compatibility — returns same state)

Pure functions:
- `initialDashboardState(): DashboardState` — returns `{ phase: 'loading', activePane: 'findings', selectedIndex: 0, detailScrollOffset: 0, specsVisible: false, shouldExit: false }`
- `dashboardTransition(state, action, findingsCount): DashboardState` — pure reducer, never mutates input
- `mapKeyToDashboardAction(key, input, activePane): DashboardAction | null` — maps keyboard input: 'q'→QUIT, tab→FOCUS_NEXT_PANE, shift+tab→FOCUS_PREV_PANE, 't'→TOGGLE_SPECS, upArrow/'k'→MOVE_UP, downArrow/'j'→MOVE_DOWN, return/enter→SELECT_FINDING (only from 'findings' pane, uses currentSelectedIndex param), escape→BACK

Create `src/tui/__tests__/dashboard-state.test.ts` following the EXACT patterns from `state-machine.test.ts`: use vitest describe/it/expect, create a `makeState()` helper with overrides, test every action from every phase/pane combination, test immutability (input state not mutated, new reference returned on transition), test key mapping for all keys and all panes. Aim for at least 40 test cases covering: initialDashboardState shape, PIPELINE_COMPLETE from loading/ready, SELECT_FINDING from each pane, FOCUS_NEXT_PANE cycling (with and without specs visible), FOCUS_PREV_PANE cycling, TOGGLE_SPECS on/off + focus migration, MOVE_UP/MOVE_DOWN in each pane, QUIT from each pane, BACK no-op, immutability, and mapKeyToDashboardAction for all mapped/unmapped keys.

steps.title: Create Pane wrapper, StatusBar, and FindingsPane components
steps.description:
Create three new component files in `src/tui/components/`. Follow the exact coding patterns from existing components: React functional components, explicit return type `React.ReactElement`, Ink's Box/Text, JSDoc comments on the component and its Props interface, Props interface exported.

1. `src/tui/components/Pane.tsx`:
   - Props: `{ title: string; focused: boolean; children: React.ReactNode }`
   - Renders a `<Box flexDirection='column' borderStyle='round' borderColor={focused ? 'cyan' : 'gray'}>` wrapping children
   - Title row: `<Box><Text bold={focused} color={focused ? 'cyan' : 'gray'}> {title} </Text></Box>` above children inside the border
   - This is the foundational container for all panes

2. `src/tui/components/StatusBar.tsx`:
   - Props: `{ findingCount: number; activePane: DashboardPane; phase: DashboardPhase }` (import DashboardPane, DashboardPhase from `../dashboard-state.js`)
   - Renders two sections: a header Box and a footer Box
   - Header: `<Box><Text bold color='cyan'>Support Bundle Investigator</Text><Text color='gray'> — {findingCount} finding(s)</Text></Box>`
   - Footer: `<Box><Text color='gray' dimColor>` with context-sensitive keybindings. Always show: [tab] switch pane  [t] toggle specs  [s] export  [q] quit. When activePane is 'findings': prepend [↑↓/jk] navigate  [enter] select. When activePane is 'detail': prepend [↑↓/jk] scroll. When activePane is 'specs': just show the always-shown bindings.
   - Export separate `StatusBarHeader` and `StatusBarFooter` components (or a single component with `variant: 'header' | 'footer'` prop) so App.tsx can place them at top and bottom of the layout

3. `src/tui/components/FindingsPane.tsx`:
   - Props: `{ findings: Finding[]; selectedIndex: number; focused: boolean }`
   - Wrap everything in `<Pane title='Findings' focused={focused}>`
   - Render a column header row: `SEV    CONF  TAG  TITLE` (same as Dashboard.tsx)
   - Map over findings to render rows identical to Dashboard.tsx: selection indicator ('▸'/'  '), severity badge via severityColor/formatSeverityLabel padEnd(8), confidence via confidenceBar padEnd(6), source tag via sourceTag padEnd(5), truncated title via truncateTitle(title, 40) — use 40 instead of 60 since pane is narrower
   - If findings.length === 0, show 'No findings.' in gray
   - Import Finding from `../../types/index.js`, helpers from `../helpers.js`

steps.title: Create DetailPane and SpecsPane components
steps.description:
Create two new component files in `src/tui/components/`. Follow existing component patterns.

1. `src/tui/components/DetailPane.tsx`:
   - Props: `{ finding: Finding | null; scrollOffset: number; focused: boolean }`
   - Wrap in `<Pane title='Detail' focused={focused}>`
   - When `finding` is null: render `<Text color='gray'>Select a finding to view details</Text>` as placeholder
   - When finding is present, render the same sections as `DetailView.tsx` but adapted for pane layout:
     a. Title + severity badge + confidence (same as DetailView lines)
     b. Differential diagnosis context using `extractDifferentialContext()` — show rank, root cause, runner-up comparison box (same logic as DetailView)
     c. Full reasoning summary with `<Text wrap='wrap'>`
     d. Evidence items with `evidenceIcon()`, path, note
     e. Contradictions checked as bulleted list
     f. Missing evidence as bulleted list  
     g. Recommended action in a bordered green box
   - Apply scrollOffset via the same line-slicing pattern as DetailView: build an array of React elements, clamp scrollOffset, slice from that offset
   - Import helpers from `../helpers.js`, Finding from `../../types/index.js`

2. `src/tui/components/SpecsPane.tsx`:
   - Props: `{ recommendations: SpecRecommendation[]; focused: boolean }`
   - Wrap in `<Pane title='Spec Recommendations' focused={focused}>`
   - Render spec recommendations with the same type badge logic as `SpecsView.tsx`: typeBadge() helper returning { label, color } for 'collector'/'analyzer'/'redaction', then colored badge + description + rationale
   - If recommendations.length === 0: show 'No spec recommendations.' in gray
   - Import SpecRecommendation and SpecRecommendationType from `../../reporters/index.js`

steps.title: Create DashboardLayout orchestrator component
steps.description:
Create `src/tui/components/DashboardLayout.tsx` — the multi-pane layout orchestrator. This is a pure presentational component with no state management.

Props interface `DashboardLayoutProps`:
- `findings: Finding[]`
- `recommendations: SpecRecommendation[]`
- `state: DashboardState` (import from `../dashboard-state.js`)

Layout structure using Ink Box flexbox:
```
<Box flexDirection='column' width='100%'>
  {/* Header */}
  <StatusBarHeader findingCount={findings.length} activePane={state.activePane} phase={state.phase} />

  {/* Main content area */}
  <Box flexDirection='row' flexGrow={1}>
    {/* Left column: ~35% width */}
    <Box width='35%'>
      <FindingsPane findings={findings} selectedIndex={state.selectedIndex} focused={state.activePane === 'findings'} />
    </Box>

    {/* Right column: ~65% width */}
    <Box flexDirection='column' width='65%'>
      {/* Detail pane — takes remaining space */}
      <Box flexGrow={1}>
        <DetailPane finding={selectedFinding} scrollOffset={state.detailScrollOffset} focused={state.activePane === 'detail'} />
      </Box>

      {/* Specs pane — shown when specsVisible */}
      {state.specsVisible && (
        <Box>
          <SpecsPane recommendations={recommendations} focused={state.activePane === 'specs'} />
        </Box>
      )}
    </Box>
  </Box>

  {/* Footer keybindings */}
  <StatusBarFooter findingCount={findings.length} activePane={state.activePane} phase={state.phase} />
</Box>
```

Derive `selectedFinding` as `findings[state.selectedIndex] ?? null` inside the component body.

Import all pane components from their respective files. Import DashboardState from `../dashboard-state.js`. Import Finding from `../../types/index.js`, SpecRecommendation from `../../reporters/index.js`.

steps.title: Integrate DashboardLayout into App.tsx and update exports
steps.description:
This is the integration step that wires everything together. Modify existing files.

1. **Modify `src/tui/components/App.tsx`**:
   - Replace `import { initialState, transition, mapKeyToAction } from '../state-machine.js'` with `import { initialDashboardState, dashboardTransition, mapKeyToDashboardAction } from '../dashboard-state.js'`
   - Replace `import type { TUIState } from '../state-machine.js'` with `import type { DashboardState } from '../dashboard-state.js'`
   - Replace `const [navState, setNavState] = useState<TUIState>(initialState())` with `const [dashState, setDashState] = useState<DashboardState>(initialDashboardState())`
   - Add `import { DashboardLayout } from './DashboardLayout.js'`
   - Keep existing imports: ProgressView, ExportStatus, buildReport, writePipelineResult
   - Remove imports of Dashboard, DetailView, SpecsView (old full-screen views)
   - Update `PIPELINE_COMPLETE` dispatch: `setDashState(prev => dashboardTransition(prev, { type: 'PIPELINE_COMPLETE' }, 0))`
   - Update `useInput` handler: derive keyId the same way, handle 's' for export the same way (check `dashState.phase !== 'loading'` instead of `navState.view !== 'progress'`). Call `mapKeyToDashboardAction(keyId, input, dashState.activePane, dashState.selectedIndex)` and dispatch via `setDashState(prev => dashboardTransition(prev, action, findings.length))`
   - Add shift+tab detection: in useInput, if `key.tab && key.shift` then keyId = 'shift+tab' (maps to FOCUS_PREV_PANE)
   - Handle 't' input for TOGGLE_SPECS: map 't' to `{ type: 'TOGGLE_SPECS' }` in mapKeyToDashboardAction
   - Update render section: remove the old `{navState.view === 'progress' && <ProgressView ... />}` / `{navState.view === 'dashboard' && <Dashboard ... />}` / etc. conditional blocks
   - Replace with: `{dashState.phase === 'loading' ? <ProgressView steps={steps} /> : <DashboardLayout findings={findings} recommendations={report?.specRecommendations ?? []} state={dashState} />}`
   - Keep ExportStatus overlay rendering unchanged
   - Keep error state rendering unchanged
   - Update the header section: remove the old header `<Text bold color='cyan'>Support Bundle Investigator</Text>` since StatusBar handles it now. Only show the header during loading phase.

2. **Modify `src/tui/state-machine.ts`**: Add a JSDoc deprecation comment at the top: `@deprecated Use dashboard-state.ts for pane-based navigation. This module is kept for backward compatibility.` Do NOT delete any existing functions or types — they are tested and may be imported externally.

3. **Modify `src/tui/index.tsx`**: Add new exports alongside existing ones:
   - `export { initialDashboardState, dashboardTransition, mapKeyToDashboardAction } from './dashboard-state.js'`
   - `export type { DashboardPane, DashboardPhase, DashboardState, DashboardAction } from './dashboard-state.js'`
   - Keep ALL existing exports from state-machine.ts and helpers.ts unchanged

4. **Verify**: All existing tests in `src/tui/__tests__/state-machine.test.ts` must still pass (old functions are untouched). All tests in `src/tui/__tests__/dashboard-state.test.ts` must still pass. `tui-import.test.ts` and `tui-cli-integration.test.ts` must still pass. The build must succeed with the updated App.tsx.
